projects.title: Wrioter
projects.description: Online-only writing software for complex multi-chapter projects. Features mindmaps, visualizations, and drag-and-drop organization. Laravel 11 API with a TypeScript Vue 3 / Vuetify SPA.

projects.title: 3D Printing Services Missoula
projects.description: Proof-of-concept site supporting a 3D printing hobby. Customers upload files for instant estimates before ordering; anyone can register their own 3D printing business and connect with new customers.

projects.title: MailClerk.com
projects.description: Software for SMBs in the mail-handling field to manage customers' mail and accounts. Tracks mail through multiple request types and provides an online wallet with automatic billing. Integrated with Notarize.com's API for customer validation.

projects.title: Drone & Robotics
projects.description: Building autonomous fixed-wing drones with custom electronics integration and ArduPilot flight control.

projects.title: Freynet-Gagne Customer Portal
projects.description: Portal where government agents could initiate, track, and approve changes to translations of official documents.

projects.title: LayoverBox.com
projects.description: A smart parcel-receiving mailbox built with the UBC Electrical Engineering Capstone program. Couriers drop parcels without a human clerk; SouthCo lock integration over RS-232 with a React/Electron local app. Led both the software and hardware engineering teams and chose the tech stack.

projects.title: eSnail.ca
projects.description: Software that let individuals view their postal mail online for fifteen years. Founded and directed the company from 2008 - managed three franchises in three cities and two employees, and handled taxes, payroll, and software maintenance.
